affected_system: municipal buildings, distributed energy, electrification, and emissions management
alternatives: activate a bounded reserve from forecast risk bands for municipal building energy load, cost, and emissions
use rolling forecasts and conservative capacity triggers for municipal building energy load, cost, and emissions
pair weather, occupancy, tariff, and project-conditioned load forecasting with an explicit stop, review, and escalation rule
assumptions: Meters, fuels, tariffs, weather, occupancy, equipment, projects, and emissions factors are versioned.
Modeled energy and carbon savings remain distinct from measured post-project performance.
All alternatives, capacities, costs, effects, thresholds, and failure scenarios are proposed until bound to evidence.
baseline: continue ordinary capacity planning for municipal building energy load, cost, and emissions.

constraints.description: The municipal energy and building decarbonization forecast must respect declared validated operational capacity and forecast uncertainty.
Every released metric must retain evidence type, source lineage, geography, time, assumptions, and uncertainty.
No analytical output may bypass lawful authority, accountable human review, or an applicable appeal process.

decision_cadence: recompiled at each planning cycle and after material evidence change
decision_owner: municipal energy director and public-building portfolio manager
decision_question: What interval of electric, thermal, peak, cost, and emissions load should portfolio operations prepare for?

independence_key.binding_constraint: The municipal energy and building decarbonization forecast must respect declared validated operational capacity and forecast uncertainty.
independence_key.decision_object: municipal building energy load, cost, and emissions
independence_key.evidence_gate: Evidence for municipal building energy load, cost, and emissions passes documented checks for held-out error, interval coverage, event detection, drift, and baseline comparison.
independence_key.intervention_mechanism: weather, occupancy, tariff, and project-conditioned load forecasting
independence_key.primary_outcome: energy demand above contracted and resilient capacity

intended_claim: A versioned forecast design for comparing declared alternatives affecting municipal building energy load, cost, and emissions, conditional on its evidence gate.
limitations: This library record has no city binding and therefore reports no local input, output, or recommendation.
Readiness describes explicit source and method gates; it does not certify implementation feasibility.
External domain, legal, community, security, and operational review remains outside this design artifact.

objectives.metric: energy demand above contracted and resilient capacity
distributional gap in energy demand above contracted and resilient capacity
decision claims with complete evidence lineage

prohibited_claims: Do not present forecast energy, cost, or emissions as metered performance.
Do not describe a design-only record as a city execution, deployment, adopted policy, or impact result.
Do not relabel proposed, estimated, simulated, optimized, or causal evidence as observed evidence.
Do not infer individual behavior, protected status, harm, or entitlement from aggregate records.

release_gate.failure_release: Release an explicit insufficient-evidence record naming missing sources, failed diagnostics, prohibited claims, and the next validation action.
release_gate.pass_condition: Evidence for municipal building energy load, cost, and emissions passes documented checks for held-out error, interval coverage, event detection, drift, and baseline comparison.

title: Forecast municipal building load, cost, and emissions
transportability_risks: Climate, grids, tariffs, fuels, building codes, stock, occupancy, and finance differ.
Operational changes can confound retrofit performance comparisons.
